blocks.html:
This method retrieves an exchange by its ID. It sends a request to the 
[Get Exchange](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#exchanges\_getexchangesid)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the exchange.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: exchange
children.description: The exchange's details.

children.name: id
children.description: The exchange's ID.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order this exchange is created for.

children.name: return_id
children.description: The ID of the associated return.

children.name: display_id
children.description: The exchange's display ID.

children.name: order_version
children.description: The version of the order when the exchange is applied.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the user that created the exchange.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the exchange was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the exchange was updated.

children.name: canceled_at
children.description: The date the exchange was canceled.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the exchange was deleted.

children.name: additional_items
children.description: The exchange's new (outbound) items.

children.name: return_items
children.description: The exchange's returned (inbound) items.

children.name: no_notification
children.description: Whether to notify the customer about changes in the exchange.

children.name: difference_due
children.description:
The exchange's difference amount due, either to the customer or the merchant.

If the value is positive, the customer owes the merchant additional payment of this amount.
If negative, the merchant owes the customer a refund of this amount.

children.name: return
children.description: The associated return.

children.name: order
children.description: The associated order.

children.name: allow_backorder
children.description: Whether out-of-stock variants can be added as new items.

children.name: shipping_methods
children.description: The shipping methods used to send the outbound items.

children.name: transactions
children.description: The exchange's transactions.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Key-value pairs of custom data.
